thesis: The structural story is that Alaska has run this 17-candidate race with no contribution limits since 2021, and voters decide in August whether to restore them.
key_finding: The AI-money framing COLLAPSES as a scale story ($100k is 4th-5th largest single gift in the race) and as a CAPTURE story (money and policy point the same direction, the opposite of bought-a-plank). It SURVIVES only as a COMPOSITION fact: six individuals at one employer supplied about one fifth of a $1.8M haul.
would_cut: the whole North Slope energy spine (calls it a different film; cutting from Thomas's AI-pace quote to the gas shortfall is misattribution)
Gallup 71 percent (national, unrelated to campaign finance)
the New York contrast (belongs to the policy lens, half-using it wastes it)
